name: אֵיתָן
summary: Ethan is named among the sons of Zerah, among the men whose wisdom Solomon surpassed, and in the Levitical genealogies and lists of singers. The title of Psalm 89 names Ethan the Ezrahite.
note: TIPNR groups the Levitical occurrences with the records for Joah and Jeduthun. The Hebrew numbering of the Kings passage is 5:11.
